title: ABLEIST: Intersectional Disability Bias in LLM-Generated Hiring Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Generating simulated hiring manager conversations based on candidate profiles with different disabilities (Blind, Cerebral Palsy, Autism) and evaluating the outputs using the custom ABLEIST metrics framework to detect subtle and covert ableist harms (e.g., Infantilization, Technoableism).

Varying candidate gender (Man, Woman, Transgender) in the hiring prompts alongside disability identities to measure how gender marginalization compounds intersectional harms like Tokenism and Inspiration Porn.

Modifying candidate caste identities (Brahmin, Dalit) within Indian hiring contexts to evaluate the amplification of covert biases, stereotypes, and intersectional harms towards caste-marginalized disabled candidates.
Altering candidate nationality (American, Indian) in the prompt profiles to surface cultural assumptions and compare intersectional ableist harms between Global North and Global South contexts.
